claim_scope: post-hoc diagnostic attribution for the only v1 control-envelope exceedance; not formal task selection evidence

decision_rule.query_effect: support query effect only if a query-only logical/identity change occurs or a Bonferroni-corrected lower paired bound exceeds the frozen practical margin for at least one continuous endpoint
decision_rule.no_material_query_effect: supported only if corrected upper paired bounds are below both frozen practical margins and no logical/identity change occurs
decision_rule.inconclusive: all other complete outcomes remain inconclusive; failed queries or control logical/identity changes have explicit non-causal classifications

privacy: public evidence contains pair/order labels, types, ordinals, counts, digests, anonymous deltas, intervals, and booleans only; no objectId, coordinates, exact poses, target points, or registry content
